title: Portage County police chase
summary: Merrick tells of Portage County police chase, about not stated at Portage County, Ohio, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Portage County, uh law enforcement officers chase a large metallic disc-like object for 90 minutes going 86 miles.

plain: A guest named Merrick says on Jesse Michels' podcast that police officers in Portage County, Ohio, chased a large, metal, disc-shaped object for 90 minutes over 86 miles. He offers it as a case where trained law officers followed something they could not explain for a long time.
